name: VENSUKO DropDash
description: DropDash now uses the active VENSUKO Launcher account to submit worldwide records, without a second login.

items: DropDash automatically detects the signed-in account when opened through VENSUKO Launcher.
Worldwide personal bests are submitted through the local launcher connection, without a second password.
Account credentials remain in the launcher and are never shared with the game.
Standalone game launch still offers local records and public worldwide rankings.
Added a one-second collision protection grace period after the Ghost power-up visibly expires.
Collecting consecutive cyan cores now grows the score combo by 25% per core, up to x5; missing a core resets the streak.
Added current streak, best streak and collected-core counts to the HUD and results.
New worldwide top-ten leaderboards for each ranked mode and difficulty, read from the online service.
VENSUKO account holders can optionally sign in to submit their personal bests; local high scores remain available offline.
Online leaderboards enforce account ownership and validation. Practice mode remains unranked.
Added a local top-10 leaderboard for each game mode and difficulty, including player names and personal bests.
Introduced Rush 30, a fast 30-second score challenge, and Practice with three lives and no ranked scores.
Classic now has a clear five-wave finish; Endless difficulty scales progressively for longer runs.
Fixed Slow-Mo: hazards and collectible spawning slow together with falling movement, preventing dense obstacle walls.
Improved hazard spacing with safe-lane checks and removed double-slowing of newly spawned obstacles.
Refined mode descriptions, run results and HUD labels in English, German and Polish.
Native macOS editions now available for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
Prepared DropDash for a split desktop-plus-Android release lane without changing desktop gameplay.
Added touch controls that stay hidden on non-touch desktop devices.
Refreshed the desktop archive metadata after rebuilding the standalone native runtime.
Migrated DropDash from a browser launch flow to a standalone native Tauri desktop runtime.
Kept gameplay, visuals, controls, and scoring identical to the previous release.
Prepared archive-based delivery for launcher updates and public upload.
